Dataset Card for TreeOfLife-10M
	


	
		
	
	
		Dataset Summary
	

With over 10 million images covering 454 thousand taxa in the tree of life, TreeOfLife-10M is the largest-to-date ML-ready dataset of images of biological organisms paired with their associated taxonomic labels.
